claim: Amazon SNS supports message payloads up to 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) when the MaximumMessageSize topic attribute is configured; without that setting topics accept messages up to 256 KiB. To set the attribute above 256 KiB, the topic must have 100 or fewer total subscriptions, all of supported endpoint types (Amazon Data Firehose, Amazon SQS or AWS Lambda).

qualifiers.condition: Opt-in per topic; the default stays 256 KiB. Above 256 KiB only with 100 or fewer subscriptions, all Amazon Data Firehose, Amazon SQS or AWS Lambda.

evidence.quote: Amazon SNS supports message payloads up to 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) when you configure the MaximumMessageSize topic attribute. By default, topics accept messages up to 256 KiB.
To set MaximumMessageSize above 256 KiB, the topic must have 100 or fewer total subscriptions, all of which must be supported endpoint types (Amazon Data Firehose, Amazon SQS, or AWS Lambda).
